title: Meaningless Constructor/Destructor Comments
pattern: Comments or doc-comments placed on simple constructors or destructors that offer no explanation beyond the function's trivial identity.
why_bad: Clutter. It adds zero semantic information while disrupting visual scanning of the struct definition.
detection: Doc-comment on `pub fn new()` or `impl Default` that reads 'Default constructor', 'Creates a new struct', or identical phrases.
counterexample: A constructor doc-comment documenting non-obvious effects, such as spawned background threads, acquired locks, or registered global state.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4 ("Noise Comments"), Chapter 17 (G12: "Clutter").
